metric_definitions.positive_event_s2_recall: positive cases with at least one valid S2 in the frozen event window / qualified positive cases
metric_definitions.positive_full_window_s2_recall: positive cases with at least one valid S2 in the frozen case window / qualified positive cases
metric_definitions.negative_event_new_confirmation_rate: negative cases whose first new S2 transition occurs in the frozen event window / qualified negative cases; inherited pre-event S2 is not a new confirmation
metric_definitions.negative_event_s2_exposure_rate: negative event-window case-days in S2 / all qualified negative event-window case-days
metric_definitions.confirmation_lag_sessions: trading sessions from frozen event_start to first valid event-window S2; misses are reported separately and never imputed
metric_definitions.churn_rates: S0->S1->S0, short reversal, reversal and total transition counts per 100 eligible case-days

minimum_pass.incremental_value_required: at least one additional positive event hit versus baseline OR at least 10% reduction in negative exposure or any two churn rates, with no other hard guardrail regression

hard_fail: Any minimum_pass threshold or hard contract guardrail is missed on an otherwise valid and independent run
Performance is poor; poor performance must never be relabeled INCONCLUSIVE
V4-A loses to baseline on event recall, new false confirmations, or negative exposure beyond the frozen tolerances
Improvement is attributable only to one or two positive cases under the leave-two-out test
Any NULL, Freeze, evidence-signature, state-transition, future-read or deterministic contract violation attributable to the candidate
inconclusive_only: Frozen case data qualification failure or certified data-version corruption
External source becomes unavailable and prevents the frozen evidence contract from being verified
Unresolved label conflict or evidence error discovered after freeze
Episode independence or result-blindness is shown to have been broken
Execution infrastructure failure before a valid complete comparison exists
one_time_rule: Once any formal case result for baseline or V4-A is computed or viewed, the casebook is CONSUMED and cannot be reused for tuning or another formal holdout.
